description: The file defines the OperationalCountry entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the 'ohrm_operational_country' database table. It includes properties for 'id' and 'country', with ORM annotations for Doctrine ORM integration, and provides getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: OperationalCountry
classes.description: Entity class representing an operational country in the OrangeHRM system, with ORM mappings to the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the operational country.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the operational country.
